about: The walkthrough's voice-over: the intro, every caption in walkthrough.cast (from script.sh) as it appears, and the outro. `say` gives the spoken form of a caption where it differs from the text on screen. narrate.py voices them; term.js holds each caption until its line has finished, and render.mjs writes brand/media/walkthrough.vtt.
intro: Record, learn, review, audit and serve a flow, on the official MCP filesystem server, with the release binaries and no key. Every command runs as shown.
outro: The walkthrough, step by step, is in the docs.

say.stretto doctor checks the binaries on PA: stretto doctor checks the binaries on your path and the stretto folder in your home directory, and says what a key would add. Nothing here needs one.
say.Its next steps go to stderr; the rest of: Its next steps go to standard error; the rest of this walkthrough runs them. A scripted agent starts the proxy with the same arguments.
say.Use the agent as usual. Here a scripted: Use the agent as usual. Here a scripted agent stands in for the LLM: it searches the notes and reads what it finds, through the proxy, which records each session in the stretto folder, under logs.
say.With the flow, served by the proxy behin: With the flow, served by the proxy behind the agent's calls. It has no arbiter, so the proxy decides with reach, asking no model.
